Both intents explicitly state the expected 100% first-timer protection and its reachability for such users.
The 30% actual reward is the consequence of the first-timer protection being unreachable; the same preconditions and explicit intents about 100% first-timer treatment directly apply.
The 70% swept amount is the complement of the intended 100% first-timer reward; the preconditions and explicit intents about first-timer protection directly concern this loss.
No explicit intent source states an expected behavior about recourse or claim correction; the available intents concern first-timer reward percentage, not recourse.
